audience: managed service providers that run tickets, clients and assets in HaloPSA

useCases.title: Check open tickets for a client
useCases.text: List the tickets, filtered by client, status or open state. Open one ticket and read its notes, oldest first.

useCases.title: Look up a client's sites, users and assets
useCases.text: List the clients and the sites of one client. List its end users and its assets.

useCases.title: Open a ticket for a customer
useCases.text: Create a ticket with a summary. Customers may see the ticket, so check the text before you create it.

useCases.title: Set the status, priority or agent of a ticket
useCases.text: List the ticket statuses and the agents. Update one ticket to set its status, priority or agent.

useCases.title: Add an internal ticket note
useCases.text: Add a note to one ticket. Set it as hidden from the user to keep it internal. The tool does not send e-mail.

useCases.title: Review invoices for a client
useCases.text: List the invoices of one client for a date range. List the clients to find the client id.
